entries.name: ActiveConcernRow
entries.note: New finding beyond the 2026-08-05 audit. postgres-adapters/shared.ts declares the raw Postgres row (salience number|string|null; evidence_refs/formation_vad unknown pre-parse) while concerns.ts declares the narrower normalized row shape. Genuinely different shapes under one name; rename one (e.g. ActiveConcernPgRow) or derive the raw row from the canonical one.

entries.name: AdminTaskCadence
entries.note: New finding beyond the 2026-08-05 audit. Both files declare the identical alias `type AdminTaskCadence = RecurringCadence`. Consolidation candidate: scheduler-service.ts should import the admin-contract.ts alias (or both should use RecurringCadence directly).

entries.name: Awaitable
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (m1): `type Awaitable<T> = T | Promise<T>` is declared in 12 files, but only these two export it; this gate scopes to exported definitions so the unexported copies are out of scope. Fix per audit: one export from src/shared/utils/types.ts with import swaps everywhere.

entries.name: BeadsAction
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (m9): protocol.ts hand-writes the union while enablement.ts derives it from ALL_BEADS_ACTIONS (whose header claims single-source-of-truth). Values match today; the scanner flags the spelling difference as a collision, so this is a drift risk, not a true semantic conflict. Fix: protocol.ts imports the type from enablement.ts (no cycle risk).

entries.name: CogSecCompactionInvalidationResult
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (c1): different shapes (number[] ids plus caseId/channelId vs composite string[] ids) bridged by a deliberate adapter in operator/garden/services/session-service.ts. The identical name for pre- and post-mapping shapes is the defect. Fix: rename the revocation-side type (e.g. CogSecCompactionRevocationOutcome).

entries.name: ConcernCandidateExtractionContext
entries.note: Reviewed by audit lane 2 and deliberately left unflagged: concern-candidate-types.ts is a plain alias (`= MemoryConcernCandidateExtractionContext`) to the canonical interface in memory/extraction/types.ts. The scanner classifies alias-vs-interface as a collision by spelling; this is name reuse for a single definition, not duplication.

entries.name: EchoStreamingTtsConfig
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (m11): the pair has already drifted (url vs baseUrl, nullability) and index.ts `export *`s echo-stream while declaring a conflicting local export, so which type you get depends on the import path. Fix: rename the index.ts provider-settings shape (e.g. EchoTtsProviderSettings).

entries.name: FleetAuthRole
entries.note: New finding beyond the 2026-08-05 audit. Same four role values, spelled two ways: hand-written union in authority-lifecycle-types.ts vs const-derived `typeof FLEET_AUTH_ROLES[number]` in fleet-auth-config.ts. Values match today but nothing enforces it; consolidate so one side imports from the other (config owner file side should own the const).

entries.name: FleetRestoreDatabaseOperation
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (m5): identical `{ operationId, operationIdentity }` in the same package. Fix: the marker file exports and the transaction file imports. The audit also notes the parallel state union duplicated under two names in the same files.

entries.name: LLMCompletionModelHint
entries.note: New finding beyond the 2026-08-05 audit. Both files declare the identical alias `type LLMCompletionModelHint = LLMModelHint`. Consolidation candidate: keep the alias in one module (model-hint-routing owns hint semantics) and import it in the other.

entries.name: ManagedSkillRecord
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (m12): admin-contract.ts hand-copies the store.ts fields minus absolutePath/relativePath, so added fields do not propagate. Fix: derive with `Omit<ManagedSkillRecord, 'absolutePath' | 'relativePath'>` from the canonical store type.

entries.name: MetacognitiveFlagName
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (m3): both sides derive from a 5-flag const; the consts are literal-for-literal identical, so values match. The scanner flags the spelling difference (METACOGNITIVE_FLAG_NAMES vs METACOGNITIVE_FLAG_HINT_NAMES) as a collision. Fix: macro-hints.ts imports the const (or at least the type) from the canonical self-model-contracts.ts.

entries.name: PolicyContext
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (M3): trust-layer disclosure context vs gateway RPC-gate `{ method, params, callerClass }` — different domains under one load-bearing name. Fix: rename the gateway pair to GatewayPolicyContext (with GatewayPolicyDecision).

entries.name: PolicyDecision
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (M3): trust values 'allow'|'deny'|'sanitize' vs gateway values 'ALLOW'|'DENY'|'NEEDS_APPROVAL' — different domains and casing conventions under one load-bearing name. Fix: rename the gateway pair to GatewayPolicyDecision (with GatewayPolicyContext).

entries.name: PromptSectionScopeResolver
entries.note: Reviewed by audit lane 2 and left unflagged as borderline: two function-type aliases whose return types (PromptSectionScopeProvenance vs PromptSectionTelemetry['scopeProvenance']) resolve to the same underlying shape; the provenance file documents the UI contract relationship. Rename is optional.

entries.name: ReflectionExecutionSource
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (m7): identical 4-member union in two files that live in one import graph, so values flow between the two spellings today. Fix: runtime-helpers re-exports from reflection-substrate (persistence owns the persisted discriminator).

entries.name: ReflectionPublishInput
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (m4): byte-identical 5-field interface in two parallel auto-publishers. Fix: share the input type from one place (e.g. a shared integrations module or the reflection runtime).

entries.name: RuntimeMode
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (M1): canonical process-topology mode 'split'|'gateway-agent' vs a single-literal 'gateway' stub in the tool-wiring validator — disjoint value sets, and the stub is imported by production code. Fix: rename the validator type (e.g. ToolWiringValidationMode).

entries.name: SatelliteRoutingMetadata
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (M2): fully-required registry wire snapshot vs all-optional agent-internal delegation hint — structurally incompatible shapes, and the port type's name claims a canonical-contract meaning it does not have. Fix: rename the port type to SatelliteDelegationRoutingHint.

entries.name: ScratchpadEntry
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (m8): identical `{ id, content, createdAt, updatedAt }`. The narrow synchronous ScratchpadProvider port is deliberate, but re-declaring the record shape is not. Fix: scratchpad-port imports the record from memory-store-port.

entries.name: ShardAuditTrail
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (m6): identical one-method interface in the same subsystem. Fix: move to shards/types.ts or have tool-sync import from manager — check the import-cycle direction first per the audit's caveat.

entries.name: ShardCreationMode
entries.note: Reviewed by audit lane 2 and deliberately left unflagged: shards/types.ts is a plain alias (`= RoutingShardCreationMode`) to the canonical union in shared/routing/envelope.ts. The scanner classifies alias-vs-union as a collision by spelling; this is name reuse for a single definition, not duplication.

entries.name: SubagentExecutionRequest
entries.note: Re-verified against current code: the audit's 'plain alias' dismissal no longer holds. bounded-subagent-contract.ts aliases its local narrow BoundedSubagentLaunchRequest (required maxTurns, mutable string[] capabilities) while faculties/subagents/types.ts declares a wider interface (workSpec, optional maxTurns, readonly capabilities). Genuinely different shapes under one name; rename the bounded alias (e.g. BoundedSubagentExecutionRequest).

entries.name: TextEmotionDType
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (m2): values identical (same 9 dtypes), spelled two ways — hand-written union in runtime-base.ts vs const-derived in text-classifier.ts. The scanner flags the spelling difference as a collision. Fix per audit: add a compile-time tie (satisfies/assertion test), since shared/contracts importing from core/emotion may invert the allowed layering.

entries.name: TurnSnapshot
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (c2): voice state-machine snapshot vs persisted turn record snapshot — unrelated domains, both legitimately named. The audit did not flag this as a defect; a rename is optional. Baselined so the gate stays green while the names are deliberate.

entries.name: WebSocketVoiceSession
entries.note: Audit lane 2 (m13): the channels/api type is the primitives type minus connectionId. Low drift stakes. Fix: derive with `Omit<WebSocketVoiceSession, 'connectionId'>` from the primitives transport type.
